a2t_calibration_d1_basis: Unlike the sealed frozen 400 -- whose ids are inside the base D1 closure and which therefore declares NO supplement -- these ids are new media that duplicate nothing in that closure, so an additive supplement is both needed and legal under contracts.gate_media_identity.
a2t_calibration_exposure: The same frozen 400 discovery split, re-encoded. Nothing is drawn. Media row SAEA-SN-MF-A2T-CAL400-16K-MEDIA-V1. This fragment grants no contact authority.
a2t_calibration_identity_hash_convention: a2t_calibration_split_identity_hash is SHA-256 over the LF-joined sorted sample ids of THIS variant; a2t_calibration_flight_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('audio2tool', sample_ids)), the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time. Both differ from the sealed frozen 400's and from the other variant's, which is the identity separation the '@' suffix exists to guarantee.
a2t_calibration_rate_rule: 16 kHz mono int16, produced by reproduction.obs_loop.decode_parent_pcm (librosa.load(sr=16000, mono=True), res_type 'soxr_hq', librosa 0.11.0 / soxr 1.1.0), then clip(rint(float32 * 32767), -32768, 32767). The decoder is pinned by the SHA-256 of its own source text and the build refuses if ffmpeg appears on PATH, because decode_parent_pcm would prefer it.
